$comment: The emit half of the typecheck-only root config: the same strict baseline, emitting ESM plus declarations to dist/ so CI proves the TypeScript pipeline produces loadable output — not a bundler, not a build system, just the compiler and what it must do for a library package. Tests are not shipped. `allowImportingTsExtensions` is a noEmit-only flag and is turned off here explicitly; src/ has no relative imports to break anyway while the tree is a canary.
